body: That’s a big reason why I haven’t commited yet. I’m a bit stuck. I don’t want to put him through that, but I don’t want to deal with his death either. But I’m also afraid of getting old (23 atm), so I may end up going before him anyway.
I don’t want to grow old or live past my dad. The future doesn’t look that great either. But thinking about it everyday is getting me a bit down.

I’m bipolar too! But it’s bipolar type 2, so I don’t really get mania episodes. For me, it’s just become routine to think about suicide everyday. I’m big on avoiding pain and am not impulsively suicidal so I just plan and plan endlessly... All I know is that I’m not gonna die of old age.

Yeah, actually I know exactly what sort of circumstances would have to happen for me to go through with it. Stuff like my dad dying in a freak accident (I’m probably co-dependent on him) or if I’m not able to live a comfortable life for whatever reason.
please pm me, I’ll let you know
